subject: general
question: A shopkeeper allows successive discounts of 20% and 10% on every item. At what price is an article marked for ₹500 available to customers?
solution:
**Given: **

MP = 500

Allowed successive discount = 20% & 10%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Here, 20% = 1/5 & 10% = 1/10

 
 

 Initial 
 After Discount
 
 

 5
 4
 
 

 10
 9
 
 

 50 Units
 36 Units
 
 

Here, 50 Units = 500

1 Unit = 10

36 Units = 360

∴ The Price of the article 360.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Formula Used: **

For Successive discount = - a - b + ab over 100 

**Calculation: **

Successive discount = - 20 - 10 + 20 × 10 over 100% = 28%

So, total discount = 500 × ²⁸/₁₀₀ = 140

**∴ The Price of the article = 500 - 140 = 360**
